pages.title: Battle With Mortus
pages.text: Battle With Mortus is the music of the last fight in Comix Zone, when Mortus himself comes into the comic. He throws General Alissa Cyan into a tank of rising liquid and taunts Sketch Turner, "What's the matter now, Sketch? Gettin' chicken?" Its drum part has more than 550 notes, the most of any Comix Zone song.

pages.title: The hero and the villain
pages.text: In Comix Zone, the hero and the villain share a voice. According to the game's credits, composer Howard Drossin voices both Sketch Turner and Mortus.
